lede: The school board votes Monday on a flood-damage budget appropriation that will reshape district spending for the year ahead — summer flooding hit the 5th grade pod, the high school cafeteria, and the Palm Theatre complex, and the repair bill is real. Layered on top of that, the Ethics Commission takes up a formal Code of Conduct recommendation for Town officials on Tuesday, the hospital board weighs a possible Two Site Model for the new facility on Wednesday, and Mountain Village's TMVOA moves to stand up a Workforce Housing Committee later in the week.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-related budget appropriation affecting district spending this year.
Commission recommends whether Town establishes a binding Code of Conduct for officials.
Hospital board may act on Two Site Model, shaping what gets built and where.
County weighs CCAP childcare funding cuts and budget implications for Human Services.
TMVOA votes on workforce housing committee formation and updated association policies.
